_doc: Per-node overrides applied by gen_nodes.py on top of techtree.json. impl = A (exists, text matches), B (exists, differs: lane implements the difference or rewords and sets A), C (new, existing systems), D (new gameplay; the offers text here is the closest honest Sunday version). Offers/gate_text below replace design promises that cannot ship by Sunday. See IMPLEMENTATION.md.

first_raid_aftermath.offers: Survive your first raid and the hamlet becomes a Village: ring 2 opens in every branch, and your guards may wear mail.

town_charter.offers: Become a Town: ring 3 opens and visiting merchants bring fuller purses.

castle_charter.offers: Become a Castle: ring 4 opens, merchants bring fuller purses again, and with the Master Armoury your best fighters may wear diamond.

kingdom_crown.offers: Crown yourself: Kingdom rank, the fullest merchant purses, and with the Master Armoury your captains may wear netherite.

guard_drill.offers: Guards train harder and earn +15% combat XP.

commanders_horn._lead_decision: 26 Sep: command keys stay FREE for everyone; the node adds reach, duration and a rally.
commanders_horn.offers: Your captain's voice carries: orders reach soldiers up to 80 blocks away instead of 48, last longer after an alarm, and every order sounds a horn that rallies the listeners (+10% speed for 10 seconds).

barricades.offers: When a raid is spotted, every Builder drops other work to raise your marked barricades first, and barricade lines may be twice as long.

shield_doctrine.offers: Guards holding a line take 30% less damage from the front, and earn +25% combat XP.

archer_longbow_drill.offers: Archers shoot 2 blocks farther and draw their bows faster.

crossbows.offers: Archers switch to heavy bolts: slower shots, but every hit does 40% more damage.

watchfires.offers: When the alarm sounds, villagers run for shelter 25% faster.

palisade.offers: Your palisade becomes a fighting wall: raiders need twice as many blows to break a palisade segment.

earthworks.offers: Raiders near your defense lines are slowed to a crawl.

stone_walls.offers: Stone wall segments take three times as many blows to break.

veteran_techniques.offers: Guards master their moveset: faster shield bashes, a longer combo window and harder heavy strikes.

master_armoury.offers: Your smiths learn to work diamond and netherite: Gear Tier 3 with the Castle Charter, Tier 4 with the Crown.

high_runes.offers: Your mages master the high runes: a second Rune Mage and longer wards.

knights._lead_flag: Mounted knights (horses + mounted combat AI) cannot ship by Sunday; honest version is a guard perk.
knights.offers: Order of Knights: your Sergeants and Captains fight as knights, +25% damage and no knockback.

pike_square.offers: Spearmen doctrine: braced Spearmen strike 50% harder and cannot be knocked back.

stout_straps.offers: Couriers carry 2 more items on every trip.

warehouse_racks.offers: The plaque now recognises Warehouse level 3, the Storehouse: 64 managed containers.

courier_ledger.offers: Couriers serve urgent and high-priority requests first.

porters_guild.offers: Heavy loads: Couriers carry 50% more, but walk 10% slower.

runners_guild.offers: Swift feet: Couriers walk 15% faster and wait less between jobs.

mule_cart._lead_flag: Mules/Stable not in scope; honest version is cart tier 3 without animals.
mule_cart.offers: Heavy carts: cart tier 3, +400% carry, and 20% faster on roads.

caravan_routes._lead_flag: Outposts do not exist; honest version uses the existing Caravan world event.
caravan_routes.offers: Trade caravans come to your Banner far more often.

builders_hut.offers: Hire a Builder: they fill the gaps on any building's checklist for you, build starter blueprints, and make barricades.

tannery.offers: A Tanner cures hides into leather and Cured Hide.

charcoal_kilns.offers: The Smelter burns its own charcoal: smelting 25% faster.

deep_mine.offers: The Miner digs two levels deeper and finds extra ore on 15% of ore blocks.

masters_apprentices._lead_flag: Pairing/follow/inheritance is L; honest version is an XP boost.
masters_apprentices.offers: Workers who share a workshop with a master (trade level 5+) learn 50% faster.

guild_halls._lead_flag: Extra worker slots touch 6+ call sites; honest version is better crafted quality.
guild_halls.offers: Each trade's guild raises the bar: crafted goods roll Fine or better far more often.

feather_quilts.offers: Settlers who sleep a full night under quilts wake up Well Rested and work faster all morning.

bards_songbook.offers: The bard plays to a crowd: evening morale lifts higher, and visiting travellers throw Coins.

kitchen_and_hall.offers: Build a Kitchen and a Dining Hall: a Cook feeds the village at one long table.

war_feast.offers: When a raid is spotted and the Banner holds 12 meals and 4 ale, the village feasts: guards fight 10% harder and hold their nerve that night.

two_storey_houses.offers: Home tier 2: Townhouses. Every House may hold two more settlers.

wayside_shrine.offers: A small chapel: after every victory the village gives thanks, and everyone's morale lifts.

alehouse.offers: A proper alehouse: a Brewer brews ale, and a pint lifts spirits more than ever.

infirmary.offers: Build an Infirmary: wounded settlers inside heal steadily.

manors._lead_flag: Master travellers/families/Elder are L; honest version is capacity + morale.
manors.offers: Home tier 3: Manors. Houses hold two more settlers again, and the finest homes lift everyone's spirits.

great_tavern.offers: Your Tavern becomes a famous inn: minstrels and caravans visit far more often.

harvest_feast._lead_flag: Decorations/maypole/visiting crowds are L; honest version is a morale + work-speed festival day.
harvest_feast.offers: Hold a harvest festival every few days: morale lifts and the village works faster the next day.

hall_of_heroes._lead_flag: Memorial plaques/nemesis trophies are L; honest version softens grief.
hall_of_heroes.offers: Honour the fallen: the village grieves less when someone dies, and newcomers arrive in better spirits.

hall_and_learning._lead_decision: 26 Sep: approved '+1 trade level for new recruits'.
hall_and_learning.offers: School: new settlers arrive already trained, one level ahead in their trade.

cathedral._lead_flag: Blessing picks/curses are L; honest version is victory morale + a second Blessing seal if the blessing lane can.
cathedral.offers: A cathedral rises over the town: after every victory the whole village's morale soars.

hall_of_revels.offers: The greatest hall in the land: Tavern prices double and the bard's evenings lift twice as high.
